firmware.note: fox-bench's own firmware for the ESP32-C3 (C, ESP-IDF, GPL-3.0-or-later): the fox.json contract and the network templates of the CircuitPython foxes, without CircuitPython. No USB drive: fox.json and defaults.json travel over the serial console (PROTOCOL.md, "Files over the console") on the same USB lead that flashes the board. Planned: the firmware source lands next; until then the target is listed and disabled.
firmware.build_info_note: written by CI beside the .bin: {version, commit, idf, gcc, sha256, size, built}; the Board tab shows it and checks a fetched image against sha256/size
